Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The study employs multiple proteomics approaches (XL-MS, DDA-LFQ, IP-MS). The primary biological variables include disease status (COVID-19 vs Healthy), ligand supplementation (Spike vs No Spike), and genetic overexpression (ApoD/Spike plasmids). Ligand stimulation is mapped to the parent category as the specific 'spike protein' is a viral glycoprotein rather than a standard cytokine/growth factor listed in fine-grained classes.
